category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, and Procedures (PR.PO-P)
subcategory_text: Configuration change control processes are established and in place.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CM-3 (Configuration Change Control), CM-4 (Security and Privacy Impact Analyses)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 PR.PS-02 (change management)
implementation_examples: Define and operate a change-control process that evaluates privacy impact before applying changes to systems or services that process personal data
Track change requests, approvals, tests, and post-implementation review
Ensure emergency changes are retroactively reviewed against the same criteria
assessment_objectives: Determine whether change-control processes exist for personal-data processing systems
Determine whether the process evaluates privacy impact before change approval
Determine whether emergency changes are subjected to the same review after-the-fact
Determine whether post-implementation reviews capture privacy outcomes
